title: nephrodium auriculatum
intro: Nephrodium auriculatum, commonly known as the auriculated lady fern or auriculated fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. The health benefits of this plant include its potential use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium auriculatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds may also possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, contributing to the plant's overall therapeutic profile.
